card.name: Decimal point after a leading zero
card.fires_on: The decimal point right after a leading 0 in a number, as in 0.5 mCi, 0.2% or 0.9% sodium chloride. It fires in doses, concentrations and percentages.

modes.label: Dose and range values
modes.description: Decimal point after 0 in dose amounts or ranges with units like mCi or mmol/kg.

modes.label: Percentages and concentrations
modes.description: Decimal point after 0 in incidence rates or solution strengths such as 0.9% sodium chloride.
